records.rawDisplayText:
In projects, let's create a new project called Purple. I want a good architecture diagram using excalidraw.

DNS is at digital ocean
Load Balancer is at GCP
Now it goes to K8s cluster. Ingress controller accepts the traffic.
React App scaled horizontally. Rails app scaled horizontally. Same with NodeJS. Metabase is deployed which is opensource via helm. Prometheus, Loki and grafana is deployed as well. redis as caching layer is deployed as well. All of this is deployed using argocd.

Data layer is at Mysql which is gcp managed with a read replica.

The project is there but it's not rendering
